# Welcome to my website! (Under construction)

I am Yi-Chen Li (Ethan), a master’s student in Economics at National Taiwan University (NTU), and I was previously a visiting student at University of California, Berkeley. I study international trade, political economy, economic history, and applied econometrics.

As a double major in Political Science and Economics during my undergraduate studies, I became fascinated by how economic shocks and globalization reshape social values and political life. Much of my thinking is inspired by [Karl Polanyi's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karl_Polanyi) [The Great Transformation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Great_Transformation_(book)).

Outside economics, I am broadly interested in history, philosophy, and social theory. Recently, I have been reading more in the philosophy of science and art history. In my free time, I enjoy classical music---I once played the saxophone---as well as independent music with inventive arrangements.

Feel free to [contact me](mailto:ethanli.taiwan@gmail.com) if you would like to connect or discuss any of the topics explored on this website.
:::
